AddTag.description:
Put a lasting condition, edge, or burden on an entity. The sheet shows the id written
out: `battle-worn` appears as Battle Worn.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

tag_id.description: Stable slug for the tag, such as `poisoned`.
tag_id.title: Tag Id

text.description: The constraint or benefit it puts on the entity, in prose.
text.title: Text

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.
why.title: Why

AddTag.title: AddTag

AdjustCounter.description: Move a counter up or down. The change is clamped to the counter's own bounds.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

counter.description: Exact key of one of that entity's counters, as its sheet spells it.
counter.title: Counter

delta.description: How much the pool moves: negative to reduce.
delta.title: Delta

maximum.description: A new upper bound for the pool. Advancement only.
maximum.title: Maximum

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.
why.title: Why

AdjustCounter.title: AdjustCounter

GainImprovisedItem.description:
Give the player an ordinary incidental object that is not in canon and is not worth a canon
entry of its own. Never a substitute for an item that already exists.

item_name.description: The object written out, such as 'a handful of gravel'.
item_name.title: Item Name

GainImprovisedItem.title: GainImprovisedItem

MoveActor.description:
Move an actor who actually changes location. Moving the player to an unrevealed location
reveals it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the actor to move; null moves the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

location_id.description: Exact id of the location the actor enters.
location_id.title: Location Id

MoveActor.title: MoveActor

MoveItem.description:
Move one item within the player's reach: pick it up, set it down here, or hand it to an
actor here.

item_id.description: Exact id of the item: one the player carries, or one loose at their location.
item_id.title: Item Id

to_id.description: Exact id of the receiver: an actor here with the player, or the player's own location to set the item down. Null hands the item to the player.
to_id.title: To Id

MoveItem.title: MoveItem

OutcomeBranch.description: What follows in the fiction if the action lands on this outcome, and only then.

outcome.description: One outcome label the chosen action allows.
outcome.title: Outcome

effects.description: What that outcome causes in the world.
effects.title: Effects

OutcomeBranch.title: OutcomeBranch

RemoveTag.description: Lift a tag an entity carries, when the fiction ends it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

tag_id.description: Exact id of a tag the entity carries.
tag_id.title: Tag Id

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.
why.title: Why

RemoveTag.title: RemoveTag

Reveal.description:
Reveal an entity that exists but the player does not know yet: they notice it, are told of
it, or reach it. Prefer this over inventing a replacement.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the unrevealed canon entity.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

Reveal.title: Reveal

Risk.description: The one thing this engine resolves: an uncertain attempt, settled by 2d6 against a 7.

actor_id.description: Exact id of the actor taking the risk: the player, or an actor here.
actor_id.title: Actor Id

approach.description: How they go about it; that approach's number on their sheet is the bonus.
approach.title: Approach

difficulty.description: How hard it is: risky costs nothing, demanding -1, extreme -2.
difficulty.title: Difficulty

helping_tag_id.description: Exact id of the one tag that directly helps — an edge, a bond, or a gear benefit on an item that actor carries. Null when none does.
helping_tag_id.title: Helping Tag Id

hindering_tag_id.description: Exact id of the one tag on that actor's sheet that directly hinders — a burden or a condition. Null when none does.
hindering_tag_id.title: Hindering Tag Id

stakes.description: What is attempted, in a few words; it names the roll.
stakes.title: Stakes

Risk.title: Risk

SetNote.description:
Write freeform bookkeeping the fiction needs remembered and no counter or tag holds, such as
what a caster concentrates on. Writing a key again replaces what it held.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

key.description: What the note is about, such as `concentration`.
key.title: Key

text.description: The note; empty clears whatever the key held.
text.title: Text

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.
why.title: Why

SetNote.title: SetNote

SetNumber.description:
Set a number the fiction has lastingly changed — armour worn, a permanent blessing. Never
for this turn's outcome: pools that go up and down are counters.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

key.description: Exact key of a number already on that sheet.
key.title: Key

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.
why.title: Why

SetNumber.title: SetNumber

SpendCounter.description: Pay from a counter, which refuses outright when the pool cannot cover it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the entity affected; an actor must be here with the player.
entity_id.title: Entity Id

counter.description: Exact key of one of that entity's counters, as its sheet spells it.
counter.title: Counter

amount.description: How much of the pool is spent.
amount.title: Amount

why.description: One short sentence saying what causes this change, for the player.
why.title: Why

SpendCounter.title: SpendCounter

intent.description: 1-3 sentences for the Narrator: what the player attempted and what is at stake. Never an outcome, a number, or a die.
intent.title: Intent

tone.description: A few words of mood. Atmosphere only: 'tense and hushed', not 'they find it'.
tone.title: Tone

speaker_id.description: Exact id of the NPC the player addresses — one they have met and who is here with them — or null if nobody is addressed.
speaker_id.title: Speaker Id

effects.description: Consequences that happen whatever the action settles.
effects.title: Effects

branches.description: Consequences keyed by outcome: at most one branch per label, and only labels this action allows. Outcomes that do not occur simply never apply. An action rolled to cause a lasting change — a condition taking hold or lifted, something revealed — must carry that change in the matching outcome's branch: with no branch, even success changes nothing.
branches.title: Branches

action.description: The one risk this turn resolves, or null when nothing is uncertain enough to roll for.
